using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task SendCheckpointMetadataAsync_LogsInformationOnSuccess()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
        var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
        var mockCkptManager = new Mock<ICkptManager>(); // Assuming interface exists or can be mocked
        var mockGcs = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>(new System.Net.IPEndPoint(System.Net.IPAddress.Loopback, 0), null, null, null, null, null, null);

        mockGcs.Setup(x => x.ExecuteSendCkptMetadata(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<int>(), It.IsAny<byte[]>()))
               .ReturnsAsync("OK");

        // Setup mockClusterProvider to return mockCkptManager
        mockClusterProvider.Setup(x => x.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>()))
                          .Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);

        var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
            mockStoreWrapper.Object,
            mockClusterProvider.Object,
            logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        // Note: This tests the specific LogInformation call on line 463
        // We verify the logger was called with the expected message template and arguments
        await session.SendCheckpointMetadataAsync(mockGcs.Object, Guid.NewGuid(), CheckpointFileType.STORE_SNAPSHOT, mockCkptManager.Object);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogInformation(
                "<Complete sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}",
                It.IsAny<Guid>(),
                It.IsAny<CheckpointFileType>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task SendCheckpointMetadataAsync_LogsInformationWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Arrange
        var fileToken = Guid.NewGuid();
        var fileType = CheckpointFileType.STORE_SNAPSHOT;
        
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
        var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
        var mockCkptManager = new Mock<ICkptManager>();
        var mockGcs = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>(new System.Net.IPEndPoint(System.Net.IPAddress.Loopback, 0), null, null, null, null, null, null);

        mockGcs.Setup(x => x.ExecuteSendCkptMetadata(
                It.Is<byte[]>(b => StructExtensions.ToGuid(b) == fileToken),
                (int)fileType,
                It.IsAny<byte[]>()))
               .ReturnsAsync("OK");

        mockClusterProvider.Setup(x => x.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>()))
                          .Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);

        var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
            mockStoreWrapper.Object,
            mockClusterProvider.Object,
            logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        await session.SendCheckpointMetadataAsync(mockGcs.Object, fileToken, fileType, mockCkptManager.Object);

        // Assert - Verify exact parameters were logged
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogInformation(
                "<Complete sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}",
                fileToken,
                fileType),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
